# Job Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 418v

---

**7:1** "Is-there-not a-hard-service [tsava] for-man [la-enosh] upon the-earth [al ha-arets],
and-like-the-days of-a-hired-worker [sakhir] his-days?

**7:2** Like-a-slave [ke-eved] who-pants-for [yish'af] the-shadow [tsel],
and-like-a-hired-worker [sakhir] who-waits-for [yeqavveh] his-wages [po'olo].

**7:3** So I-am-made-to-inherit [honechalti] months of-emptiness [yarchei shav],
and-nights of-trouble [leilot amal] are-appointed [minnu] to-me.

**7:4** When I-lie-down [shakhavti] I-say, 'When will-I-rise [aqum]?'
And-the-evening drags-on [middad arev], and-I-am-filled [sav'atiy] with-tossing [nedudim] until dawn [neshef].

**7:5** My-flesh [besariy] is-clothed [lavash] with-worms [rimmah] and-clods of-dust [gush afar];
my-skin [oriy] hardens [raga] and-runs [vayimma'es].

**7:6** My-days [yamay] are-swifter [qallu] than-a-weaver's-shuttle [mi-ni arag],
and-they-end [vayikhlu] without [be-efes] hope [tiqvah].

**7:7** Remember [zekhor] that a-breath [ruach] [is] my-life [chayyay];
my-eye [einiy] will-not return [lo tashuv] to-see [li-re'ot] good [tov].

**7:8** Not will-see-me [lo teshurenniy] the-eye of-the-one-seeing-me [ro'iy];
your-eyes [einekha] [will be] on-me and-I-will-not-be [ve-einenniy].

**7:9** A-cloud [anan] is-consumed [khalah] and-goes [vayelakh];
so the-one-going-down [yored] to-Sheol will-not come-up [lo ya'aleh].

**7:10** He-will-not return [lo yashuv] again to-his-house [le-veito],
and-his-place [meqomo] will-not know-him [lo yakkirennu] again.

**7:11** Also I — I-will-not restrain [lo echsokh] my-mouth [piy];
I-will-speak [adabberah] in-the-distress [be-tsar] of-my-spirit [ruchiy];
I-will-complain [asichah] in-the-bitterness [be-mar] of-my-soul [nafshiy].

**7:12** Am-I the-sea [ha-yam] or-a-sea-monster [tannin],
that you-set [tasim] a-guard [mishmar] over-me?

**7:13** When I-say [ki omriy], 'My-bed [arsiy] will-comfort-me [tenachemeiniy],
my-couch [mishkaviy] will-bear [yissa] my-complaint [be-sichiy],'

**7:14** then-you-terrify-me [vechitataniy] with-dreams [ba-chalomot],
and-from-visions [u-me-chezyonot] you-frighten-me [teva'atanniy].

**7:15** And-chooses [vattivchor] my-soul [nafshiy] strangling [machnaq],
death [mavet] rather-than my-bones [me-atsmotay].

**7:16** I-loathe [ma'astiy] — I-will-not live [lo le-olam eche'eh] forever;
leave-me-alone [chadal mimmeniy], for a-breath [hevel] [are] my-days.

**7:17** What [mah] is-man [enosh] that you-make-him-great [tegaddellennu],
and-that you-set [tashet] your-heart [libbkha] upon-him,

**7:18** and-you-visit-him [vatifqedennu] every-morning [li-beqarim],
every-moment [li-rega'im] you-test-him [tivchannennnu]?

**7:19** How-long [kammah] will-you-not look-away [lo tish'eh] from-me?
Will-you-not let-me-alone [lo tarpeniy] until I-swallow [ad bil'iy] my-spit [ruqqiy]?

**7:20** If I-have-sinned [chatati], what do-I-do to-you [ef'al lakh],
Watcher of-man [notser ha-adam]?
Why have-you-set-me [samtaniy] as-a-target [le-mifga] for-you,
and-I-have-become [va-eheyeh] a-burden [le-massa] upon myself?

**7:21** And-why do-you-not pardon [tissa] my-transgression [pish'iy]
and-take-away [ta'avir] my-iniquity [avoniy]?
For now in-the-dust [la-afar] I-will-lie-down [eshkav],
and-you-will-seek-me [ve-shichartaniy] and-I-will-not-be [ve-einenniy]."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.12 — "Am I the sea or a sea-monster?":** The *yam* and *tannin* are chaos forces from ancient Near Eastern mythology. Iyyov asks why God guards him as if he were a cosmic threat — the irony being that God's surveillance feels like imprisonment, not care.

**v.17-18 — Parody of Psalm 8:** These verses deliberately echo Psalm 8:4 ("What is man that you are mindful of him?"), but invert its meaning. In the psalm, divine attention is a source of wonder and gratitude; in Iyyov's mouth, it becomes relentless, suffocating surveillance.

**v.20 — "Watcher of man":** The epithet *notser ha-adam* ("Watcher/Guardian of humanity") transforms a title of divine care into an accusation of divine stalking.

---
*— EMET*
